+    # Processes next token from scanner
+    #
+    # @param [StringScanner] scanner
+    #
+    # @return [WLex::Token, nil]
+    #
+    # @api private
+    def process_next_token(scanner)
+      return nil if ignore_current_char?(scanner, scanner.peek(1))
+
+      log_lexeme_names if debug
+      longest_token = find_longest_match(scanner)
+      current_char = scanner.peek(1)
+      if longest_token
+        process_matched_token(scanner, longest_token, current_char)
+      else
+        process_unmatched_token(scanner, current_char)
+      end
+    end
+
+    # Checks if current character should be ignored
+    #
+    # @param [StringScanner] scanner
+    # @param [String] current_char
+    #
+    # @return [Boolean]
+    #
+    # @api private
+    def ignore_current_char?(scanner, current_char)
+      return false unless @dsl.state_ignore[current_state].include?(current_char)
+
+      scanner.pos += current_char.size
+      @char_pos_in_line += current_char.size
+      true
+    end
+
+    # Logs lexeme names for current state
+    #
+    # @api private
+    def log_lexeme_names
+      logger.info "lex: [#{current_state}]: lexemes = #{@dsl.state_lexemes[current_state].map(&:name)}"
+    end
+
+    # Finds the longest matching lexeme
+    #
+    # @param [StringScanner] scanner
+    #
+    # @return [WLex::Lexeme, nil]
+    #
+    # @api private
+    def find_longest_match(scanner)
+      longest_token = nil
+      @dsl.state_lexemes[current_state].each do |lexeme|
+        match = lexeme.match(scanner)
+        next if match.nil?
+
+        longest_token = match if longest_token.nil?
+        next if longest_token.value.length >= match.value.length
+
+        longest_token = match
       end
+      longest_token
+    end
+
+    # Processes a successfully matched token
+    #
+    # @param [StringScanner] scanner
+    # @param [WLex::Lexeme] longest_token
+    # @param [String] current_char
+    #
+    # @return [WLex::Token, nil]
+    #
+    # @api private
+    def process_matched_token(scanner, longest_token, current_char)
+      move_by = longest_token.value.length
+      if longest_token.action
+        new_token = longest_token.action.call(self, longest_token)
+        return skip_and_return_nil(scanner, move_by, longest_token.name) if new_token.nil? || !new_token.is_a?(Token)
+      end
+      update_position_and_advance(scanner, longest_token, current_char, move_by)
+      longest_token
+    end
+
+    # Skips matched token and returns nil
+    #
+    # @param [StringScanner] scanner
+    # @param [Integer] move_by
+    # @param [Symbol] token_name
+    #
+    # @return [nil]
+    #
+    # @api private
+    def skip_and_return_nil(scanner, move_by, token_name)
+      scanner.pos += move_by
+      @char_pos_in_line += move_by unless token_name == :newline
+      nil
+    end
+
+    # Updates position tracking and advances scanner
+    #
+    # @param [StringScanner] scanner
+    # @param [WLex::Lexeme] longest_token
+    # @param [String] current_char
+    # @param [Integer] move_by
+    #
+    # @api private
+    def update_position_and_advance(scanner, longest_token, current_char, move_by)
+      start_char_pos_in_token = @char_pos_in_line + current_char.size
+      longest_token.update_line(current_line, start_char_pos_in_token)
+      advance_column(move_by)
+      scanner.pos += move_by
+    end
+
+    # Processes unmatched token (error handling)
+    #
+    # @param [StringScanner] scanner
+    # @param [String] current_char
+    #
+    # @return [WLex::Token, nil]
+    #
+    # @api private
+    def process_unmatched_token(scanner, current_char)
+      return handle_error_token(scanner, current_char) if @dsl.state_error[current_state]
+
+      complain("Illegal character `#{current_char}`")
+      nil
+    end
+
+    # Handles an error token
+    #
+    # @param [StringScanner] scanner
+    # @param [String] current_char
+    #
+    # @return [WLex::Token, nil]
+    #
+    # @api private
+    def handle_error_token(scanner, current_char)
+      token = Token.new(:error, current_char)
+      start_char_pos_in_token = @char_pos_in_line + current_char.size
+      token.update_line(current_line, start_char_pos_in_token)
+      new_token = @dsl.state_error[current_state].call(self, token)
+      advance_column(current_char.length)
+      scanner.pos += current_char.length
+
+      return nil unless new_token.is_a?(Token) || !new_token.nil?
+
+      new_token
     end
